name: Lightning Rod

passives.name: Call Lightning
passives.effects: Automatically river summon a storm cloud above you, which strikes a lightning bolt at your current location after 1.5 seconds to deal 135 – 230 (based on level) magic damage (+30% bonus AD) (+50% AP) (+10% of target's maximum health) magic damage to enemies within the area and slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. If you are within the lightning strike, gain a shield equal to 14% of your maximum health (+75% AP) for 2 seconds.

passives.name: Fully Automated
passives.effects: Automatic river effects have their cooldown reduced by 1 second and now benefit from your ability haste. Call Lightning's cooldown cannot be reduced below 5 seconds by this effect.

description:
500 Health
30 Armor
30 Magic Resist
20 Ability Haste


Call Lightning
Every 16 seconds, Autocast summon a stormcloud above you, which after a brief delay fires a lightning bolt, dealing plus 10% max Health magic damage and Slowing by 30% for 2 seconds.

If you are struck by the lightning, gain a Shield for 2 seconds.

Fully Automated
Your Autocast spells benefit from your Ability Haste.

Call Lighting has a minimum cooldown of 5 seconds.
